item.tib: tshe sgrub 'od dkar dpag med kyi cha lag bla 'gug srog gi ka ba
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshe sgrab ye shes gra gur gyi bla 'gug srog gi ka ba 'di yang / gshen 'chi med gtsug phud kyis tshe bdud nag po dam la btags nas/ gshen gsang ba 'dus pa la bstan/ des stag la sogs rim gyis brgyud nas dran pa nam mkha' la brgyud/ des rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum mang du phyes nas/ grol thob sems dpa' brgyad la gdams/ dus der ban btsun phrag dog dbang gis bon bsnubs nas bstan pa rin po che gter du gshegs/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis bon 'di zab par gzigs nas gter kha gsum du sbas/ cha gcig rgyung srub gsang ba'i brag la sbas/ cha gcig tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi (gyis) phyag tu bsnams nas/ ma dros g.yu yi mtsho mo khrus kyi rdzing bu'i nang du gter du sbas/ gter srung rdo rje 'bar ba dang klu mo dkar mo la gnyer du gtad/ phyis su rten 'brel dus la bab nas/ spral sku blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'dzin/ tshe dbang bde chen snying po bdag la gter kha gsum dgongs pa chig dril du dngos grub bab nas yod skabs/ las can gyi skyes bu shes rab phun tshogs nas/ skye ba sngon nas lha skal du phog pa'i 'phro sad de bskul ba dang*/ ma zad bla chung tshul khrims bstan 'dzin dang*/ nye gnas bstan sbyin dpal sdis dang / dkon mchog bstan mchog sogs 'ga' yis bskur (bskul) ba la brten nas/ shar grol smin gling du yi ger btab te (ste) 'bri ba po ni/ sa trig ming gis bskrun pa'o//
